scope: Fingerprint generation, native media API consistency, Firefox proxy routing, HTTP response rewriting and browser lifecycle
changes: Bridge all configured HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS5 upstreams, including unauthenticated proxies; reject missing required upstreams before local forwarder allocation
Keep upstream credentials in the bridge and stop startup before browser spawn when Worker CA trust fails
Use Node HTTP framing and stream ordinary resources with backpressure; buffer only JavaScript Worker responses
Decode gzip/deflate/Brotli Worker responses with 16 MiB limits for encoded and decoded stages; remove stale validators and disable caching of rewritten scripts
Handle close-delimited responses, chunk trailers, empty bodies, HEAD, bodyless statuses, streaming uploads and HTTP upgrades
Own and close Worker proxy resources on normal stop and failed startup; request Firefox native BiDi browser.close before forced cleanup
Remove codec-matrix runtime hooks: MediaRecorder, WebCodecs and RTP capabilities remain native and agree with actual SDP negotiation
Export and activate OS/browser support validation; reject incompatible profiles without changing sampled fingerprint seeds
Make Firefox Worker native tests await completed navigation and process exit rather than fixed delays

validation.generation: 240 legacy identity digests and 2000 version-2 profiles passed
validation.emittedScriptParsing: 147 document scripts and 147 worker scripts passed
validation.nativeCodecGate: Uninjected Windows baseline and injected Windows/Linux passed function descriptor, WebCodecs validation, recorder MIME, RTP dictionary, SDP and replay checks

nativeFirefoxFullEngineProbe.method: Actual BrowserEngine.start/stop with an independent copied Firefox kernel, NSS trust installation and loopback first-script observations; external exit discovery stubbed and non-local traffic assigned an unavailable loopback upstream

initialRunFollowup: A repeated shell-process fixture stop failed; replaced polling subprocesses with one Node fixture and added native BiDi graceful stop. Final routing and cleanup checks passed.
One Chromium initial-target attach timed out in the initial aggregate. Isolated and final aggregate native-contract runs passed without changing its timeout.

An initial Firefox chained Worker test failed after fixed-delay navigation. Tests now require completed native navigation and verify document.documentURI before constructing relative Worker URLs. Final native Worker gate passed.
An additional native probe reproduced Linux RTP/H264 capability versus SDP disagreement after partial filtering. Removed the incomplete runtime capability hooks; native cross-surface checks passed.
limits: Linux execution does not certify native Windows/macOS GPU, font, media-device or vendor-kernel behavior.

Firefox Worker prefixing certifies newly fetched JavaScript HTTP(S) responses that traverse the forwarder; blob/data, previously cached scripts, static module dependencies and local proxy bypasses remain outside the first-instruction guarantee.
Codec support remains native; no cross-OS codec emulation is claimed.
Firefox interception uses Node TLS and HTTP/1.1; it does not reproduce native Gecko TLS/HTTP2 fingerprints.
Native test no-sandbox flags are confined to the local container test environment, not application defaults.
